palette.dominance_rule: Paper Ivory / white-light space must dominate most editorial frames; cobalt/blue acts as structural field, not full-time darkness.
palette.dark_usage_rule: Charcoal is text/anchor only, not the dominant field.

typography.text_density: one headline maximum + one micro-caption maximum

episode_specific_motifs.name: Laptop as editorial portal
episode_specific_motifs.description: The company laptop is photographed/illustrated as the single hero object and becomes a portal into maps, evidence, identity and the final reflection.

episode_specific_motifs.name: Cobalt route + brass annotation
episode_specific_motifs.description: Spatial and causal relationships use thin cobalt routes with restrained brass/gold highlights over ivory paper.

episode_specific_motifs.name: Layered identity paper fragments
episode_specific_motifs.description: Identity/interview/device/work/account signals appear as editorial paper cards, photo cutouts and printed annotations rather than dashboard UI.

unique_transition_motif.name: Laptop-edge page turn
unique_transition_motif.description: The laptop lid/screen edge becomes a page/panel wipe into the next editorial composition; use selectively, not as a repeated preset.

frame_family_assignments.purpose: Opening visual identity and title promise

frame_family_assignments.family: F10 Modern Reality + F08 Object Macro
frame_family_assignments.purpose: Ordinary home + hero laptop grounded in reality
Official evidence presented as paper/document editorial frame
Device in U.S. / human elsewhere; route and location contrast
Return to opening laptop with changed meaning

art_direction_guardrails: Ivory/white-light field dominates; black/dark is never the default background.
No decorative architecture that does not serve the story.
Classical/botanical cutouts remain supporting editorial texture, never literal story claims.
Maps/diagrams look printed/illustrated, not SaaS dashboards.
Every frame must explain, prove, reveal, orient, or reset.
lock_condition: Owner approves the new Style Frame set; only then may PP03 become ART_DIRECTION_LOCK and PP04 begin.
owner_approval_basis: Owner previously confirmed the bright ivory/white Editorial Renaissance Motion direction and instructed to continue work after the restart.
